title: Law to create an e-bike trade-in voucher program
summary: This bill would require the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection, working with the Department of Transportation, to set up a program letting people trade in certain powered bicycles for a new class one or two e-bike at reduced or no cost, or for a voucher redeemable at a bike shop. The agency would host at least one trade-in event per year in every community district and run a public outreach campaign in multiple languages. Participants could receive only one bike and could not resell it for a year.
